slice.summary: Compared tracked main-branch Detector 0 claim, contract, validation, source, and no-pretrained evidence against the M3HJ target spec, with read-only side-worktree metadata review.

goal.mission: Mission 3HJ - Detector 0 training accuracy spec fit

strict_gate_current_metrics.selection_rule: maximize recall among validation-frame thresholds under false-positive-rate limit 0.05

target_spec_comparison.gate: scratch-trained project detector with no pretrained CV/sign/landmark/model dependencies
target_spec_comparison.required: Scratch-trained Detector 0 artifact, no pretrained dependencies, no pretrained feature caches, no runtime extractors.
target_spec_comparison.current_evidence: No trained Detector 0 artifact exists. Detector 0 card has status not_trained, promotion_state research_only, browser_artifact null, and pretrained_components empty. No-pretrained audits passed.
target_spec_comparison.blocker: No trained scratch Detector 0 artifact is tracked or promoted.

target_spec_comparison.gate: approved source/provenance for all training and validation annotations
target_spec_comparison.required: Source/provenance evidence for every Detector 0 training and validation annotation.
target_spec_comparison.current_evidence: Source register audit passed for 12 sources. Existing diagnostic packet evidence is PopSign-v1 based and manually verified/corrected, but M3HJ found no spec-complete Detector 0 training/evaluation manifest and label audit for all target IDs.
target_spec_comparison.blocker: Current provenance is sufficient for the narrow diagnostic packet, not for a complete Detector 0 training/evaluation claim.

target_spec_comparison.gate: output targets compatible with Detector 0 target IDs
target_spec_comparison.required: Outputs for left_or_first_hand, right_or_second_hand, head_or_face, and upper_body_or_signing_space.
target_spec_comparison.current_evidence: detector0-card.json and detector0-types.ts define the four target IDs. The current strict-gate learned evidence is only a diagnostic right-hand/contact-gate path with fixed geometry for other regions and no trained multi-target browser artifact.
target_spec_comparison.blocker: The target schema exists, but no trained artifact currently emits validated multi-target Detector 0 outputs.

target_spec_comparison.gate: in-domain hand-visible recall at IoU 0.30 at least 0.98
target_spec_comparison.current_evidence: No spec-level IoU 0.30 recall report exists. The strict validation-frame 5 percent FPR threshold records presence recall 0.0575, and M3FR packet validation recall is 0.14285714285714285 at the contract threshold.
target_spec_comparison.blocker: Required IoU 0.30 recall metric is missing and current diagnostic recall is far below target.

target_spec_comparison.gate: in-domain hand-visible recall at IoU 0.50 at least 0.90
target_spec_comparison.current_evidence: No spec-level IoU 0.50 recall report exists. M3FR records packet-frame present_box_mean_iou values only as diagnostic microprobe evidence, not full detector recall at IoU 0.50.
target_spec_comparison.blocker: Required IoU 0.50 recall metric is missing.

target_spec_comparison.current_evidence: No product-scope false no-hand report exists. M3FR packet validation at the contract threshold had 6 false negatives out of 7 positive rows.
target_spec_comparison.blocker: Current diagnostic false-negative behavior fails the intended false no-hand requirement and is not product-scope.

target_spec_comparison.gate: false hand-trigger rate on no-hand, empty, and low-light hard negatives at most 0.05
target_spec_comparison.current_evidence: Strict validation-frame threshold accounting records false_positive_rate 0.049375 under the narrow side-contract selection rule, and M3FR packet-frame validation FPR was 0.0. No product-scope no-hand/empty/low-light hard-negative suite exists.
target_spec_comparison.blocker: The narrow diagnostic FPR evidence is not sufficient hard-negative coverage for the target spec.

target_spec_comparison.gate: temporal jitter and missing-frame behavior measured on video sequences
target_spec_comparison.required: Video-sequence jitter and missing-frame behavior evidence.
target_spec_comparison.current_evidence: No current tracked jitter or missing-frame Detector 0 behavior report exists.

target_spec_comparison.required: 15-25ms per detector frame or a documented every-N-frames runtime policy.
target_spec_comparison.current_evidence: No browser Detector 0 artifact exists, so no browser latency evidence exists.
target_spec_comparison.blocker: Browser latency cannot be measured until a candidate browser artifact exists.

target_spec_comparison.gate: fail-closed behavior when detector confidence or fixed-crop fallback fails
target_spec_comparison.current_evidence: model-card.json is not_trained, detector0-card.json is not_trained/research_only with runtime gates false, active-vocabulary-claim.json has activeLabels empty, and the strict-gate contract audit passed its fail-closed claim-surface check.

target_spec_comparison.gate: no raw learner video upload during normal practice
target_spec_comparison.required: No raw learner video upload in normal practice.
target_spec_comparison.current_evidence: M3HJ changed no runtime upload paths, ran no media import, and preserved fail-closed browser claim surfaces. The Detector 0 trace type records rawFramePersisted false.

side_worktree_evidence_reviewed.decision: Side-worktree metadata confirms useful prior Detector 0 material exists, but M3HJ did not port it because the selected slice was the spec-fit audit receipt and current main-branch evidence already proves Detector 0 is not spec-fit.

artifact_assessment.reason: Tracked main-branch evidence contains only a fail-closed Detector 0 card and diagnostic strict-gate receipts. Current diagnostic recall, coverage, temporal, hard-negative, browser-latency, and artifact-promotion evidence do not satisfy the target Detector 0 spec.

exact_blocker: Detector 0 is not trained, accurate, or spec-fit today because main has no trained browser artifact and no complete approved Detector 0 training/evaluation manifest with target coverage and required IoU recall, false no-hand, hard-negative, temporal-jitter, and latency metrics. The strict-gate evidence is diagnostic only and fails recall/coverage.
